title: Quadrant of a Point
problem: Read two integers x and y on one line. Print Q1 if both are positive, Q2 if x is negative and y is positive, Q3 if both are negative, and Q4 if x is positive and y is negative. If the point is on an axis (x or y is 0), print Axis. For example, 3 5 gives Q1 and 0 4 gives Axis.
starter_code:
# Read x and y on one line.
# Print Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4 or Axis.

# Write your code here

hints.1: Rule out the points on an axis first; then the signs of x and y tell you the quadrant.
hints.2: Test for x or y being zero first and print Axis. After that, compare the sign of x and the sign of y with if/elif, one combination per branch.

failure_explanation: A point with a zero coordinate is on an axis and belongs to no quadrant, so test for that before the quadrants. Then check the signs of both numbers together: Q2 needs a negative x and a positive y, and Q4 is the other way round.
